crossRefs.note: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her…
Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.
